what: Preview an xlsx, docx, or pptx file — ox_view
title: Preview an xlsx, docx, or pptx file — ox_view
text: Dispatches ox_view_xlsx, ox_view_docx, ox_view_pptx based type given, otherwise x's file extension (, openxlsx2 wbWorkbook object, always xlsx viewer).

title: Preview an xlsx, docx, or pptx file — ox_view
code: ox_view(   x,   interactive = NA,   browser = FALSE,   debug = FALSE,   type = NULL,   zoom = NULL,   select = NULL )

title: Preview an xlsx, docx, or pptx file — ox_view
text: x Path URL .xlsx/.xlsm/.docx/.pptx file, openxlsx2 wbWorkbook object. interactive Whether actually open viewer. Defaults interactive(); set explicitly avoid depending session state. browser TRUE, force opening system browser instead RStudio Viewer pane. debug TRUE, show -viewer debug panel (dump viewer instance, list methods, call method argument). type Optionally force format ("xlsx", "docx", "pptx") instead guessing x's extension. Useful x URL end actual file extension (e.g. download endpoint opaque query-string path). zoom Initial zoom scale multiplier, e.g. 1.5 150%. select select/open initially - forwarded format-specific parameter makes sense: sheet name/1-based index (sheet) xlsx, 1-based page/slide number (page/slide) docx/pptx. finer control (e.g. xlsx's separate cell parameter), call ox_view_xlsx()/ox_view_docx()/ox_view_pptx() directly instead.

title: Preview a .docx file — ox_view_docx

code: ox_view_docx(   x,   page = NULL,   zoom = NULL,   background = NULL,   interactive = NA,   browser = FALSE,   debug = FALSE )

title: Preview a .docx file — ox_view_docx
text: x Path URL existing .docx file. page Page open initially (1-based). zoom Initial zoom scale multiplier, e.g. 1.5 150%. background Background color behind page (valid CSS color). interactive Whether actually open viewer. Defaults interactive(); set explicitly avoid depending session state. browser TRUE, force opening system browser instead RStudio Viewer pane. debug TRUE, show -viewer debug panel (dump viewer instance, list methods, call method argument).

what: Preview an .xlsx / .xlsm file or openxlsx2 workbook — ox_view_xlsx
title: Preview an .xlsx / .xlsm file or openxlsx2 workbook — ox_view_xlsx
text: Opens live spreadsheet preview (RStudio Viewer pane, default browser browser = TRUE) formula bar, cell reference box, sheet-name search, status bar showing count/sum/average current selection.

title: Preview an .xlsx / .xlsm file or openxlsx2 workbook — ox_view_xlsx
code: ox_view_xlsx(   x,   sheet = NULL,   cell = NULL,   zoom = NULL,   interactive = NA,   browser = FALSE,   debug = FALSE )

title: Preview an .xlsx / .xlsm file or openxlsx2 workbook — ox_view_xlsx
text: x Path existing .xlsx/.xlsm file, openxlsx2 wbWorkbook object. sheet Sheet open initially: sheet name, 1-based index. NULL (default) x wbWorkbook, workbook's current sheet used automatically via openxlsx2's private current_sheet/get_sheet_index R6 fields - reaches another package's undocumented internals (public accessor ), may break across openxlsx2 versions without notice; pass sheet explicitly sidestep entirely. cell cell reference (e.g. "B2" "B2:D5") select scroll open. zoom Initial zoom scale multiplier, e.g. 1.5 150%. interactive Whether actually open viewer. Defaults interactive(); set explicitly avoid depending session state. browser TRUE, force opening system browser instead RStudio Viewer pane. debug TRUE, show -viewer debug panel (dump viewer instance, list methods, call method argument).
